scope: memory-only single-driver v4; not full-system, durable TPS, or product p99
non_claims: no approved product TPS, p99, or fail-rate SLO; memory-only single-driver v4 is not full-system measurement; CI debug smoke is not production p99 or TPS; this apparatus does not compare PostgreSQL or select a backend
rate_meaning: fixed-origin i/rate schedule; a late driver does not shift the origin
p99_interpretation: mixed-result distribution across all call outcomes; not new-success, purchase, or product p99
service_ns_meaning: per-call kernel invocation plus outcome classification; no I/O
scheduled_latency_ns_meaning: fixed scheduled arrival through completion; rate=0 uses the call-window delay and is not a separate queueing model
goodput_interpretation: integer new Held count times 1000000000 divided by elapsed_ns; memory-only workload-loop ratio; rate>0 includes scheduled waits; not product TPS
